NgraceUXGuidelines.Audience: CLI operators, coding agents, and maintainers reading doctor/lint/status reports
NgraceUXGuidelines.Guideline: Prefer stable issue codes, exit statuses, and JSON shapes over prose-only diagnostics.
Human-readable reports must still name the machine code so agents can act without re-parsing free text.
Do not invent subcommands or flags that `--help` does not list; report gaps instead of improvising equivalents.
